Title: Initialize the runnable Next.js foundation
Description: Create the Next.js 15 App Router project with strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, Node 22 engine pin, npm scripts (dev, build, typecheck, lint, test, db:generate, db:push, db:seed, db:reset), .env.example and a minimal README run note. Do not add product features yet.
Outputs: package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.ts, Tailwind/PostCSS config, .env.example, README run section
AcceptanceCriteria: npm install completes; npm run dev serves a page; npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass on the empty app.
Verification: Run install, dev, typecheck and lint; capture commands in the P0 checkpoint note.

Title: Scaffold the app shell and design-token foundation
Description: Create src/app/layout.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/app/page.tsx and route-group folders for buyer and builder. Define the dark graphite tokens (background, surface, border, text, accent, status colours), font variables and base reset. Redirect / to /buyer/overview.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dev server renders the token palette page; / redirects to /buyer/overview; no console errors; no hard-coded colours outside tokens.
Verification: Open / and /buyer/overview; inspect CSS variables; check browser console.

Title: Freeze shared domain and API contracts
Description: Implement src/lib/contracts/constants.ts, domain.ts, schemas.ts and api.ts from 07_INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS.md. Cover Job, AcceptanceContract, AgentManifest, WorkflowGraph, EvaluationRun, ExecutionEvent, RecoveryEvent, EvidenceReceipt and API envelopes with Zod schemas and inferred TypeScript types.
AcceptanceCriteria: tsc --noEmit passes; example WH-204 payloads parse; invalid status and quantity payloads are rejected by Zod.
Verification: Run npm run typecheck and contract unit tests with valid and invalid fixtures.

Title: Add Prisma, SQLite datasource and health endpoint
Description: Add Prisma with the SQLite datasource (file:./dev.db), src/server/db.ts singleton, generate scripts and GET /api/health returning app version, database status and current time. Keep the schema Postgres-compatible where practical.
AcceptanceCriteria: prisma generate succeeds; /api/health returns 200 with database=up; a missing database file is created by db:push.
Verification: Run npm run db:push; curl /api/health; stop the DB and confirm a typed 503 response.

Title: Freeze the route map and role-aware navigation model
Description: Write src/lib/navigation.ts and a route inventory covering every page in 09_UI_UX_SPECIFICATION.md. Each item declares route, label, icon, role, section and implementation phase. No navigation item may point to an unplanned or dead route.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer and builder navigation arrays match the page list; every route has an owner phase; no dead links.
Verification: Walk the navigation arrays against the page list and click every stub route.

Title: Create the agent adapter interface and registry skeleton
Description: Implement src/server/agents/adapter.ts with the AgentAdapter interface, AgentExecutionContext, AgentExecutionResult and manifest validation. Add a registry skeleton that resolves manifests by agent/version and rejects invalid manifests. Do not add product adapters yet.
AcceptanceCriteria: Registry resolves a valid fixture manifest; duplicate agent/version and unknown capability are rejected with typed errors; tests pass.
Verification: Run the adapter contract unit test and a negative manifest fixture.

Title: P0 foundation checkpoint and tag
Description: Boot the app jointly with Teams B and C, resolve route/type/config conflicts, confirm the transport and contract assumptions, record deviations in 16_DECISIONS_AND_CHANGELOG.md and tag p0-foundation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dev server, health endpoint and typecheck pass; tag exists; no unresolved P0 blocker.
Verification: git tag --list p0-foundation; run the P0 smoke commands.

Title: P0 database and environment sign-off
Description: Review the Prisma datasource, environment variables, Node pin and script matrix with Teams A and C. Confirm SQLite JSON-as-text, paise money fields and enum-as-string conventions before schema v1 is built.
Outputs: Signed P0 environment checklist, decision log entries
AcceptanceCriteria: DATABASE_URL and demo flags documented; SQLite/Postgres differences recorded; no secret committed.
Verification: Run db:push from a clean checkout and confirm .env.example is complete.

Title: P0 contract freeze sign-off
Description: Confirm every cross-team payload has a named TypeScript type and Zod schema, resolve naming conflicts, and ensure the contracts document and code agree. Record any unapproved deviation; do not silently change a frozen shape.
Outputs: Contract sign-off note, updated decision log
AcceptanceCriteria: No unresolved TODO in src/lib/contracts; contracts doc matches code; all teams acknowledge the freeze.
Verification: Diff the contracts doc against exported types; run typecheck.

Title: Build design tokens and core UI primitives
Description: Implement the premium dark primitives: Button, Card, Surface, Badge, StatusBadge, Input, Select, Tabs, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, Money, Tooltip and Dialog. Use CSS variables and Tailwind theme mapping only; include focus-visible and reduced-motion styles.
Outputs: src/components/ui/*, updated globals.css, component stories or demo page
AcceptanceCriteria: All primitives render in the component gallery; status colours match the UI spec; keyboard focus is visible; no raw hex values in page code.
Verification: Open the component gallery at 1440 and 1024; tab through controls; run the style grep for raw hex values.

Title: Create the Prisma schema v1 and first migration
Description: Model Buyer, Builder, Agent, AgentVersion, Capability, Job, AcceptanceContract, WorkflowCandidate, CandidateStage, EvaluationRun, EvaluationFixtureResult, EvaluationAssertion, WorkOrder, WorkOrderAllocation, ExecutionRun, StageRun, ExecutionEvent, RecoveryEvent, AcceptanceResult, AcceptanceCheck, EvidenceReceipt, ContributionRecord, SettlementRecord, AgentVersionStats, InventoryLedgerEntry and IdempotencyRecord with indexes and uniques.
AcceptanceCriteria: prisma migrate dev applies cleanly; key uniques exist (agent+version, execution+stage+attempt, contribution execution+stage); relation integrity verified in Prisma Studio.
Verification: Run migrate reset, migrate deploy, and inspect the schema with prisma validate and Prisma Studio.

Title: Define capability taxonomy, schema IDs and seeded manifests
Description: Define the six capability keys, schema IDs, permission keys and manifests for Evidence Reader v1.0.0, Reconciliation Specialist v1.0.0 and v1.1.0, Exception Reporter v1.0.0 plus the evaluation-only single-agent baseline. Include pricing, latency, permissions, limitations, status and fallback links.
AcceptanceCriteria: Every required WH-204 capability maps to at least one manifest; manifests validate; baseline is marked registryVisible=false; no unmapped capability.
Verification: Run manifest validation tests and print the capability-to-manifest matrix.

Title: Implement the premium application shell
Description: Build the 240px sidebar, 64px topbar, role-aware navigation, demo environment banner, persona switcher, breadcrumb slot and responsive collapse. Use the frozen navigation model and label seeded personas clearly. Do not build page content yet.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer and builder personas switch without a full reload; active nav is correct; sidebar collapses at 1024; demo banner is always visible; keyboard navigable.
Verification: Switch personas, resize to 1024, tab through the shell; verify no layout overflow.

Title: Create the deterministic demo seed
Description: Seed Northstar Warehouse, Jordan Lee / Demo Agent Studio, four versioned agent listings, WH-204 with its acceptance contract and fixtures, the simulated inventory ledger at 42 on-hand, zero buyer spend and zero builder earnings. Use stable IDs and idempotent upserts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Running seed twice yields the same row counts and IDs; WH-204 starts CONTRACT_READY; all demo records carry isSeeded=true; no duplicate versions.
Verification: Run db:seed twice; compare deterministic ID and count queries; reset and reseed.

Title: Implement hybrid Evidence Reader and Exception Reporter adapters
Description: Build callable adapters for evidence extraction and exception reporting using a hybrid architecture: Evidence Reader calls an external model (e.g. Gemini/OpenAI via API key) to extract structured purchase order, invoice, and scan records, falling back to a deterministic local adapter on credential absence or timeout/error; Exception Reporter uses deterministic business logic. Both validate outputs against shared Zod schemas, emit trace IDs and executionMode metadata ('MODEL_BACKED' or 'DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK').
AcceptanceCriteria: WH-204 evidence yields 12/12/10 and ten unit IDs; the report cites invoice and receiving evidence; malformed input is rejected; repeat calls are deterministic.
Verification: Run adapter unit tests twice and compare JSON outputs byte-for-byte.

Title: Implement both Reconciliation Specialist versions
Description: Build deterministic Reconciliation v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 adapters. Both compute expected, invoiced, physically received and discrepancy values from the evidence packet and the authority policy; v1.1.0 additionally handles duplicate scans and malformed upstream values. Validate output schema.
AcceptanceCriteria: WH-204 yields 10 received and 2 discrepancy; exact match yields 0; missing scan fails with EVIDENCE_MISSING; v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 are independently versioned and deterministic.
Verification: Run both adapter suites on the same evidence bundle and diff the shared fields.

Title: Implement persona and dashboard summary APIs
Description: Add GET /api/me, GET /api/dashboard/buyer and GET /api/dashboard/freelancer. Return typed seeded counts, current open job, agent version counts, spend and earnings totals, with demo/simulated labels in the payload.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer response shows Northstar, one open WH-204 and zero spend; builder response shows four versions and zero eligible earnings; shapes match the contracts.
Verification: Curl both personas and validate payloads with the shared Zod schemas.

Title: Build buyer and builder overview pages
Description: Create the two overview dashboards with metric cards, open-job row, agent summary, spend/earnings placeholders, empty chart states and loading/error states. Consume the typed mock client; do not hard-code live numbers in components.
AcceptanceCriteria: Both overviews render from the typed client; persona switch changes data; loading and error states are reachable; no hard-coded values.
Verification: Toggle mock latency/error flags and inspect both pages at 1440 and 1024.

Title: Create the typed API client and mock fixture layer
Description: Build src/lib/api/client.ts plus src/lib/api/mocks.ts with fixtures for personas, dashboards, agents, jobs, compiler, auditions, work orders, executions, verification, receipts and economics. Provide NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_MOCKS and validate every mock with the shared Zod schemas.
AcceptanceCriteria: Every frozen endpoint has a typed mock; mock responses parse against contracts; switching the flag changes transport only; UI work continues while B builds APIs.
Verification: Run a mock-parity test that parses every fixture; toggle the env flag and confirm requests hit /api.

Title: Implement the agent registry read APIs
Description: Add GET /api/agents with capability, status, builderId, q and pagination filters, plus GET /api/agents/:agentId returning summary and versions. Validate queries with Zod, exclude paused/retired versions from default marketplace results, and return typed AgentSummary records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Filters combine correctly; paused versions are excluded by default; unknown agent returns 404; response parses against AgentSummarySchema.
Verification: Integration tests for each filter, an invalid status, and an unknown ID.

Title: Build the buyer marketplace catalog
Description: Create /buyer/marketplace with search, capability and status filters synced to the URL, agent cards showing builder, versions, capabilities, price and demo label, plus loading, empty and error states. Use the typed mock client until P7 integration.
AcceptanceCriteria: Filters update the URL and results; disabled versions are absent; empty and error states are reachable; cards link to agent detail.
Verification: Exercise every filter, deep-link a filtered URL, and validate card fields against the mock contract.

Title: Implement capability matching with hard filters
Description: Build the matcher that filters versioned manifests by required capability, input/output schema compatibility, permission subset, active status, budget and latency. Return eligible matches plus typed rejection reasons and capability gaps. Seed tests must prove WH-204 matches the intended agents.
AcceptanceCriteria: WH-204 matches Evidence Reader, both Reconciliation versions and Exception Reporter; paused versions and incompatible permissions are excluded with reason codes; no silent fallback.
Verification: Table-driven unit tests for capability, schema, permission, status, budget and latency failures.

Title: Implement job creation and acceptance-contract persistence
Description: Add POST /api/jobs (draft + contract v1 in one transaction), GET /api/jobs with filters and GET /api/jobs/:jobId. Validate outcome, budget, deadline, inputs and approval rules; persist a versioned AcceptanceContract and return the compiled contract preview.
AcceptanceCriteria: A WH-204-like job is created atomically; contract version is 1; invalid budget/deadline returns 400; list filters work; no orphan job without contract.
Verification: Positive creation plus invalid budget, deadline in the past and missing input tests; inspect both rows.

Title: Compile the WH-204 acceptance contract deterministically
Description: Implement the acceptance-contract compiler mapping the structured job to required capabilities, stage schemas, ten checks, approval rules and limits. Explicitly separate expectedQuantity (12), invoicedQuantity (12), scannedQuantity (10), and discrepancyQuantity (2), enforce the on-hand inventory invariant 42 -> 42 (commit blocked pending approval), and surface ambiguity warnings without inventing business rules.
AcceptanceCriteria: WH-204 compiles to expected 10/2/EXCEPTION_REQUIRES_REVIEW, inventory commit blocked, ten named checks and max 1 retry/1 replacement; ambiguous authoritative-source input is flagged.
Verification: Snapshot test the compiled WH-204 contract and a deliberately ambiguous job.

Title: Build the agent detail and version history screen
Description: Create /buyer/marketplace/agents/[agentId] with version timeline, capability list, input/output schema summary, permissions, pricing, latency, limitations, fallback link, demo evaluation placeholders and reputation slot. Version selection updates the panel without losing context.
AcceptanceCriteria: All manifest fields are visible; v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 render as distinct versions; no field is invented; deep link to a version works; responsive at 1024.
Verification: Open each seeded version and compare rendered fields against the manifest fixture.

Title: Implement schema and permission compatibility checks
Description: Build helpers that validate stage handoff compatibility: required output fields exist in the next input, JSON types match, no extra required fields are missing, and permissions are a subset of the stage scope. Return machine-readable incompatibility paths.
AcceptanceCriteria: Compatible WH-204 handoffs pass; missing field, wrong type and excess permission each fail with a path and code; exact field mapping is recorded.
Verification: Run positive and negative compatibility fixtures; assert error codes and paths.

Title: Build the three-step create-job wizard
Description: Create /buyer/jobs/new as a stepper: outcome and inputs, acceptance conditions and approval rules, budget/deadline. Add client-side Zod validation, a live acceptance-contract preview, ambiguity warnings and submit through the job API client, then route to job detail.
AcceptanceCriteria: All three steps validate; preview shows 10/2 and blocked inventory; invalid budget blocks submit; reload during the wizard preserves draft fields; submit creates a job against mocks and real API.
Verification: Complete the happy path, then attempt empty outcome, past deadline and over-budget inputs.

Title: Implement builder profile and agent registration APIs
Description: Add GET /api/builder/profile plus POST /api/builder/agents and PATCH /api/builder/agents/:agentId/versions/:versionId for demo registration/edit. Enforce builder role, unique agent+version, immutable published versions and Zod manifest validation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Builder creates a new version; duplicate version returns 409; buyer receives 403; published version edit is rejected; invalid manifest returns 400 with field paths.
Verification: API tests for create, duplicate, wrong role, published edit and invalid manifest.

Title: Implement capability-gap detection with honest outcomes
Description: When a required capability has no eligible match, return one of four typed outcomes: alternative composition, developer opportunity, human specialist or infeasible. Include what is missing and what would be needed. Never claim the platform can create a missing capability automatically.
AcceptanceCriteria: Removing the Exception Reporter capability produces a typed gap; response offers only the four honest outcomes; no auto-create language; alternatives are actually evaluated.
Verification: Run the gap fixture and assert the response shape and absence of auto-create claims.

Title: Build the buyer jobs list and job detail shell
Description: Create /buyer/jobs and /buyer/jobs/[jobId] with status badges, budget, deadline, buyer, evidence source counts and tab navigation for Contract, Compiler, Work Order, Execution, Verification, Receipt and Economics. Use real tab routes or query tabs, not dead placeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: WH-204 appears with CONTRACT_READY; tabs deep-link; unknown job shows a typed not-found; list empty state works; status semantics match the UI spec.
Verification: Navigate every tab by URL; test unknown job and empty list.

Title: Build the builder agent registration and edit form
Description: Create /builder/agents/new and /builder/agents/[agentId]/edit with manifest fields, capability multi-select, schema IDs, permissions, pricing and latency. Show a warning that published versions are immutable and that registration is demo-only.
AcceptanceCriteria: Form creates a draft version against mocks; duplicate version is blocked; immutable warning visible; buyer persona cannot access the route; validation errors are field-level.
Verification: Create a version, attempt a duplicate, and open the route as the buyer persona.

Title: Finalize seeded manifests, pricing and fallback links
Description: Load the complete manifest JSON, capability joins, permissions, prices, latency, limitations, evaluation placeholders and the v1.0.0 to v1.1.0 fallback link into the seed. Verify foreign keys and the exact seeded counts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Four marketplace versions plus one hidden baseline; v1.1.0 is a declared fallback for v1.0.0; prices and capabilities match the manifests doc; no orphan rows.
Verification: Run the seed integrity query and the fallback-link assertion.

Title: Persist workflow candidates and evaluation records
Description: Add persistence and read APIs for WorkflowCandidate, CandidateStage, EvaluationRun, EvaluationFixtureResult and EvaluationAssertion. Enforce one candidate per strategy per job, ordered stages, evaluation immutability and typed rejection reasons.
AcceptanceCriteria: Candidates and stages survive a server restart; stage order is stable; re-audition creates a new EvaluationRun rather than overwriting; unique constraints hold.
Verification: Create fixtures twice, restart the server, and read back ordered candidates and evaluations.

Title: Build the workflow graph component
Description: Implement a React Flow graph for agent, deterministic and human-checkpoint nodes with dependency edges, status colours, legend, fit-view, minimap and a node detail drawer. Include an accessible list fallback for keyboard and small screens. Do not animate decorative edges.
AcceptanceCriteria: Renders the six-stage WH-204 graph; PENDING/RUNNING/FAILED/REPLACED/AWAITING_APPROVAL states are visually distinct; node click opens details; usable at 1024.
Verification: Render each status fixture, click every node, resize to 1024, and tab through the list fallback.

Title: Generate the three bounded workflow candidates
Description: Generate Candidate A (single-agent baseline), Candidate B (fixed specialist team) and Candidate C (compiler-assembled team with declared fallback). Graph topologies, schema mappings, and fallback bindings permit any candidate to audition and potentially qualify based on measured fixture outcomes; Candidate C is not hardcoded to win.
AcceptanceCriteria: Exactly three candidates are generated for WH-204; each graph is acyclic and dependency ordered; the baseline is not marketplace-visible; incompatible graphs are rejected before audition.
Verification: Snapshot the three graphs, cycle-check them, and assert the baseline visibility flag.

Title: Implement the compile orchestration endpoint
Description: Add POST /api/jobs/:jobId/compile and GET /api/jobs/:jobId/compile. Invoke capability matching and candidate generation, persist candidates, transition the job to CANDIDATES_READY, require an Idempotency-Key and reject invalid job states with 409.
AcceptanceCriteria: Compile produces three persisted candidates; a repeat key returns the same result; invalid state returns 409; no duplicate candidate rows; job status is correct.
Verification: Call compile twice with the same and different idempotency keys; inspect rows and job status.

Title: Run the versioned audition suite across candidates
Description: Build the audition runner for ten fixtures and three candidates. Execute real adapter/deterministic functions with a fixed seed, capture outputs, assertions, cost, latency and errors, enforce timeouts, and keep two held-out fixtures out of the comparison detail.
AcceptanceCriteria: Thirty fixture results are persisted; two runs with the same seed are identical; total audition time is under 60 seconds; held-out cases are aggregated only; no LLM call.
Verification: Run the suite twice and compare a canonical hash of all results; measure duration.

Title: Build the candidate comparison matrix
Description: Create /buyer/jobs/[jobId]/candidates with three-column comparison of Candidates A, B and C across audition results, cost, latency and recovery readiness. Dynamically compute the winning candidate from persisted audition runs; display measured fixture passes (illustrative 10/10) and cost (illustrative ₹10,000) derived from runs, allowing A, B or C to win depending on criteria.
AcceptanceCriteria: Three candidates render side by side from the mock contract; A shows a critical failure; B shows no recovery; C is selected; no fabricated benchmark numbers; column details scroll at 1024.
Verification: Compare every displayed value to the audition fixture JSON; test at 1440 and 1024.

Title: Implement deterministic audition assertions
Description: Implement assertion codes for schema validity, quantities, discrepancy, evidence references, permission scope, approval gate, idempotency and recovery readiness. Assign CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR severity and emit expected vs actual values with evidence references.
AcceptanceCriteria: Known good fixtures pass all critical checks; the baseline fails the physical-quantity check; malformed and contradictory fixtures fail with the correct codes; severity is enforced.
Verification: Table-driven assertion tests with expected codes and severities for every fixture.

Title: Implement the audition execution and results API
Description: Add POST /api/jobs/:jobId/auditions and GET results. Run all candidates through the audition service, persist runs, assertions and costs, transition AUDITIONING to CANDIDATES_READY and return the comparison payload. Cap runtime and use the standard error envelope.
AcceptanceCriteria: Three evaluation runs are created; assertion counts match; a timeout returns a typed error and does not leave an infinite RUNNING state; repeat run creates a new evaluation version.
Verification: Run auditions, inspect counts, force a runner timeout and verify recovery to a terminal state.

Title: Build the compiler run and selection panel
Description: Add the compile trigger, progress states, required-capability list, matched agents, gap warnings, selected workflow rationale, audition evidence link and a CTA to the work-order step. Show the compile state machine and retry on error.
AcceptanceCriteria: Compile trigger shows idle/running/ready/error; selection ties to a candidate ID; gap state is visible; CTA is gated until selection; no dead button.
Verification: Exercise idle, running, ready, gap and error states with mock flags.

Title: Implement candidate ranking and dynamic selection
Description: Build the selection algorithm that ranks surviving candidates dynamically from persisted EvaluationRun records: hard filters first (critical assertions, schema/permission bounds, budget, deadline), then rank by audition pass rate, cost, latency and recovery readiness. Candidate A, B or C can win based on measured runs; persist SelectionResult with detailed rejection reasons.
AcceptanceCriteria: Baseline is rejected for a critical quantity failure; fixed team is rejected for no recovery; ProofHire candidate is selected; a high score cannot override a critical failure; no candidate yields a typed gap.
Verification: Selection table test with all three candidates plus a forced no-qualifier case.

Title: Author the versioned WH-204 audition fixture suite
Description: Create ten fixtures: normal short shipment, exact match, short, over-receipt, missing scan, malformed quantity, duplicate scan, contradiction, permission violation and fallback incompatibility. Mark eight visible and two held-out; version the suite as wh204-suite-v1.
AcceptanceCriteria: All fixtures parse; expected outcomes are documented; held-out flags are honoured by the runner; no fixture leaks a hidden expected value into the UI payload.
Verification: Validate the suite with Zod and run a leak test on the public comparison payload.

Title: Persist selection and expose the selection API
Description: Add POST selection persistence and GET /api/jobs/:jobId/selection. Store the selected candidate, rejected candidates, reasons, audition version and selection timestamp; transition the job to SELECTED and emit an audit event.
AcceptanceCriteria: Selected candidate is C; A and B rejection reasons are persisted; repeat selection is idempotent; job status is SELECTED; an audit event exists.
Verification: Read selection after two calls; compare reasons to the selector output and audit event.

Title: Integrate compiler and audition screens with live APIs
Description: Switch the compiler, candidate graph and comparison screens from mocks to the live compile/audition/selection endpoints. Run a mock-parity check, handle real latency and errors, and remove temporary compile fixtures from the page code.
AcceptanceCriteria: Compile, audition and selection complete through real APIs; displayed counts match persisted rows; no mock-only fields; error and retry paths work.
Verification: Run the flow with NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_MOCKS=false and compare UI values to the database.

Title: Polish graph and comparison responsiveness
Description: Tune graph and comparison layouts at 1440, 1280 and 1024. Prevent page-level horizontal overflow, keep selection and approval CTAs visible, and ensure node drawers and tables scroll independently.
Outputs: Responsive layout fixes, visual QA checklist
AcceptanceCriteria: No clipped CTA or page overflow at three widths; graph pans within its container; comparison columns remain readable; keyboard access intact.
Verification: Responsive checklist at three widths with screenshots.

Title: Optional capability-gap resolution panel
Description: If time permits, add a gap panel with the four honest outcomes: alternative composition, developer opportunity, human specialist and infeasible. Mark the bounty action as a non-functional, clearly labelled future feature; do not fake a submission.
AcceptanceCriteria: Gap response renders all four options with honest copy; disabled actions are labelled; no fake success path.
Verification: Render the gap fixture and confirm only real actions are clickable.

Title: Persist work orders and stage-level allocations
Description: Add work-order creation from a selected candidate (draft), GET work order, and POST /api/work-orders/:id/approve. Snapshot the proposed workflow, agent versions and allocation rows; enforce buyer role, valid state, allocation totals and idempotency.
AcceptanceCriteria: Work order totals 1,000,000 paise; duplicate approve returns the same record; buyer-only approval; wrong state 409; allocations sum exactly and no floating point.
Verification: Approve twice with the same key, then with a builder persona; inspect allocation sums.

Title: Build the work-order approval screen
Description: Create the work-order page with selected workflow, participating versions, ₹10,000 allocation table, platform fee, execution/recovery reserve, human-review reserve, limits, acceptance terms and a confirm-approval dialog. Label simulated settlement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Totals sum to ₹10,000 and are shown in INR; replaced v1.0.0 is not paid; approval CTA is buyer-only; simulated label visible; confirm dialog prevents double click.
Verification: Check every amount against the economics fixture; test double-click and non-buyer access.

Title: Implement the controlled workflow runtime
Description: Build the orchestrator: topological stage execution, stage contract validation, timeout policy, bounded retries, idempotency keys, cost budget, persisted events, artificial demo delays and resume from persisted stage state. No arbitrary code execution.
AcceptanceCriteria: Happy path executes six stages in order; a timeout produces a typed failure; duplicate start does not duplicate events or side effects; resume works after restart.
Verification: Run happy path, timeout fixture, duplicate-start fixture and a restart-resume test.

Title: Persist executions, stages and ordered events
Description: Add ExecutionRun, StageRun and ExecutionEvent persistence plus POST /api/jobs/:jobId/executions and GET execution status. Emit monotonic sequence numbers, store raw failed outputs, expose a polling payload and reuse an execution for the same idempotency key.
AcceptanceCriteria: Start twice returns the same execution; event sequence is unique and monotonic; failed stage output is preserved; status reloads after server restart; terminal payload is stable.
Verification: Duplicate start, ordered-event query, restart reload and terminal payload snapshot.

Title: Build the live execution monitor
Description: Create the execution page: start run, poll every 500ms with a stop condition, stage timeline, live status pulse, event log, stage detail drawer and recovery indicators. Reload must resume polling from persisted state; no fake progress timers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Observes the v1.0.0 failure and v1.1.0 replacement from mock data; polling stops at terminal; reload restores state; no duplicate network loop; 1024 layout usable.
Verification: Run against mock execution, reload mid-run, and inspect network requests for a single polling loop.

Title: Inject the controlled reconciliation failure
Description: Make Reconciliation v1.0.0 return a malformed quantity payload on its first attempt when the scenario is WH204_DEFAULT_FAILURE. Emit AGENT_SCHEMA_INVALID, preserve the raw output, and keep the behaviour off for the clean scenario. Label the injection in the UI payload.
AcceptanceCriteria: Default scenario fails stage 2 with the correct code; clean scenario does not fail; raw malformed output is persisted; injection flag is explicit; repeat runs deterministic.
Verification: Run both scenarios and inspect the StageRun error payload and trace.

Title: Persist recovery events and preserve failed attempts
Description: Add RecoveryEvent persistence and recovery read APIs. Store failure code, failed version, strategy, replacement version, compatibility checks, attempt number, cost and status; keep the failed StageRun immutable and link it to the replacement attempt.
AcceptanceCriteria: Exactly one recovery event for the demo failure; failed attempt remains queryable; replacement links both IDs; no contribution created at this stage; retry does not duplicate the event.
Verification: Read recovery, assert one event, inspect both stage attempts and the immutable raw output.

Title: Select a compatible fallback and rerun dependents
Description: Implement bounded recovery: find active versions with the same capability, compatible schemas, permission subset and available reserve; require a compatibility check; execute v1.1.0; invalidate and rerun completed downstream stages; emit recovery events.
Outputs: src/server/runtime/recovery.ts, fallback compatibility tests, downstream invalidation tests
AcceptanceCriteria: v1.1.0 replaces v1.0.0 and returns 10/2; failed version has no accepted contribution; downstream stages execute once; post-downstream failure invalidates and reruns dependents; no duplicate success event.
Verification: Run the demo failure plus a synthetic post-downstream failure; assert stage attempt and event counts.

Title: Visualize failure and replacement
Description: Show the failed v1.0.0 node in red, the v1.1.0 replacement with a dashed edge, a recovery card with error code and compatibility checks, and a preserved-output diff. Tie every visual to a persisted event; no invented animation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Failure and replacement states match the API; raw failed output is viewable; replacement identity is clear; no success styling before acceptance.
Verification: Replay mock failure/replacement and compare every label to the recovery payload.

Title: Implement idempotent demo reset
Description: Add POST /api/demo/reset and an npm reset script. Delete demo rows in FK-safe order, reseed the deterministic fixture, return the reset ID and reset state, and reject the route outside demo mode.
AcceptanceCriteria: Reset twice yields identical counts and IDs; WH-204 returns to CONTRACT_READY; no orphan rows; production flag returns 404/403.
Verification: Run reset twice, compare seed summary, and test with demo mode disabled.

Title: Build the safe-failure and escalation state
Description: Create the escalation panel for a run with no compatible fallback: stop reason, preserved evidence, affected stage, no-success copy and a human-review CTA. Do not present a failed job as completed or paid.
AcceptanceCriteria: NO_COMPATIBLE_FALLBACK renders a safe stop; no receipt or earnings CTA appears; failure reason and evidence are visible; role-appropriate actions only.
Verification: Force a no-fallback fixture and confirm no success or settlement UI.

Title: Implement safe execution limits and state invariant
Description: Enforce execution limits: max 1 retry per stage, max 1 replacement per work order, max execution budget. Enforce the warehouse inventory safety boundary invariant 42 -> 42 on-hand inventory; block commit:inventory actions and escalate to human review when discrepancy is detected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Removing v1.1.0 yields FAILED_SAFE; a second replacement is refused; reserve exhaustion stops execution; job never reaches completion or settlement.
Verification: Run no-fallback, two-replacement and reserve-exhaustion fixtures; assert terminal states.

Title: Implement the independent deterministic verifier
Description: Build a standalone verifier module that does not implement AgentAdapter and cannot be selected from the registry. It recomputes quantities from fixtures, evaluates all ten acceptance checks, ignores agent self-reported success, and emits AcceptanceResult with evidence references and status.
AcceptanceCriteria: True WH-204 result passes; a false agent success with 12 received fails; missing evidence fails; verifier is absent from registry and marketplace; all check codes are stable.
Verification: Run the positive case and five negative verifier fixtures; assert status, codes and registry isolation.

Title: Persist acceptance results and transition the job
Description: Persist AcceptanceResult and AcceptanceCheck, invoke the verifier after terminal execution, transition VERIFYING to VERIFIED_PENDING_REVIEW or VERIFICATION_FAILED, and expose GET /api/jobs/:jobId/verification. Re-verification must be idempotent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Result has ten checks and status VERIFIED_PENDING_REVIEW; re-running returns the same result; a failed check yields VERIFICATION_FAILED; no duplicate acceptance rows.
Verification: Verify twice, inspect one result row, and force a failed-check fixture.

Title: Build the verification result screen
Description: Create the verification view with ten acceptance checks (expected, actual, evidence, severity), the 10/2/EXCEPTION_REQUIRES_REVIEW result, a clear verified-pending-review seal and a before/after inventory diff showing no committed mutation.
AcceptanceCriteria: All ten checks render; a failed check is red and blocks success; diff shows 42→42 committed with pending 10 and variance 2; no settlement before acceptance.
Verification: Render the pass fixture and a failed-check fixture; compare values to the verifier JSON.

Title: Calculate the simulated inventory state diff
Description: Implement a diff calculator over the simulated ledger: committed on-hand, pending receipt, unresolved variance, proposed on-hand and commit status. The calculator must never mutate the ledger and must prove the inventory commit is blocked pending approval.
AcceptanceCriteria: Before on-hand is 42 and stays 42; pending receipt is 10; variance is 2; proposed on-hand is 52 but commit is BLOCKED_PENDING_APPROVAL; no ledger mutation event.
Verification: Run the diff against the seeded ledger and inspect the ledger row before/after.

Title: Generate the tamper-evident hash-verified evidence receipt
Description: Persist EvidenceReceipt with canonical JSON serialization (RECEIPT_BODY_V1) and SHA-256 integrity hash. Clearly label as tamper-evident / hash-verified rather than immutable; document SHA-256 limitations (proves payload integrity, does not prove physical truth of upstream inputs); link contributing versions and checks.
Outputs: src/server/evidence/receipt.ts, receipt API, canonical hashing tests
AcceptanceCriteria: Receipt includes the replaced v1.0.0 and accepted v1.1.0; hash is stable across reads; receipt has VERIFIED_PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL; no simulated value is labelled real.
Verification: Read the receipt twice and compare hashes; recompute the canonical hash independently.

Title: Build the evidence receipt viewer
Description: Create /buyer/jobs/[jobId]/receipt displaying the tamper-evident evidence receipt with copyable SHA-256 hash, verified checks list, inventory invariant (42 -> 42, commit blocked), contributing agent versions, and status VERIFIED_PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL. Explain hash integrity scope.
AcceptanceCriteria: Receipt matches API data; replaced agent is visible; hash is copyable; print CSS hides navigation; every money value is labelled simulated.
Verification: Compare each section to the receipt JSON and run a print preview.

Title: Add negative verifier regression cases
Description: Add negative cases for wrong quantity, missing scan evidence, unsupported inventory commit, contradictory report and an agent that claims success while the final state is wrong. Each must fail with a stable code and no false pass.
AcceptanceCriteria: Five negative cases fail with expected codes; no case can be rescued by another passing score; report is stored for review.
Verification: Run the negative suite and assert status FAILED plus exact codes.

Title: Enforce the human approval gate in policy
Description: Implement the policy that any inventory commit is a consequential action requiring explicit human approval. The verifier returns PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL for the commit check, direct commit attempts are blocked at the service boundary, and acknowledging the report never auto-approves inventory.
AcceptanceCriteria: Commit attempt without approval returns BLOCKED/403; report acknowledgement leaves the gate closed; audit event is written; no auto-approve path exists.
Verification: Attempt a direct commit, acknowledge the report, and inspect the gate state and audit event.

Title: Implement human review and blocked inventory commit
Description: Add POST /api/jobs/:jobId/review for acknowledge-report and request-review decisions, persist an audit event, and keep the inventory ledger untouched. Approval of the exception report must not silently commit inventory in the demo.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer can acknowledge; builder cannot; ledger remains 42; commit status stays BLOCKED_PENDING_APPROVAL; a direct commit attempt is blocked and audited.
Verification: Acknowledge as buyer, attempt as builder, attempt direct commit; inspect ledger and audit events.

Title: Build the human review interaction
Description: Add the review banner, acknowledge-report modal, blocked inventory badge and review-complete state. Make clear that acknowledging the discrepancy does not approve an inventory correction and that the ledger is simulated.
AcceptanceCriteria: Acknowledge updates the job and keeps commit blocked; copy is unambiguous; modal traps focus; builder persona sees read-only state.
Verification: Complete the buyer review flow and confirm the ledger and badge remain blocked.

Title: Add receipt export endpoints
Description: Expose GET /api/jobs/:jobId/receipt/export?format=json|md with content-disposition, the persisted receipt, a recomputed hash and no secrets. Keep the export read-only and deterministic.
AcceptanceCriteria: JSON download parses and hash matches; Markdown contains all critical sections; repeated exports are byte-identical.
Verification: Download both formats, parse JSON, and diff two exports.

Title: Optional: Wire receipt export endpoints into UI
Description: Optional scope: wire GET /api/jobs/:id/receipt/json and markdown download buttons into the receipt screen with toast feedback. Exclude from core critical path; core demo views the tamper-evident receipt directly in the Evidence Center.
AcceptanceCriteria: Both formats download with the expected filename; error state is reachable; no duplicate download on double click.
Verification: Download both files, open them, and force a 500 to see the error state.

Title: Deferred: PDF receipt export
Description: Deferred post-hackathon. A PDF rendering of the receipt is not required for the demo and introduces font/layout risk. Record it as a backlog item, do not show a disabled PDF button in the product.
AcceptanceCriteria: No PDF control exists in the demo UI; backlog entry is present.
Verification: Confirm no dead PDF action is visible.

Title: Implement stage-level contribution attribution
Description: Compute contribution amounts based on approved work order: Evidence Reader ₹2,000, Reconciliation v1.1.0 ₹2,500, Exception Reporter ₹1,000, Platform Fee ₹2,500, Reserves ₹2,000 (total ₹10,000). Enforce that failed stages (v1.0.0) receive ₹0 attribution and that retries/fallbacks never double-credit builder earnings.
AcceptanceCriteria: Evidence Reader earns 200,000 paise, v1.1.0 earns 250,000 for the reconciled stage, v1.0.0 earns 0, Exception Reporter earns 100,000; builder total 550,000; rules are persisted before execution.
Verification: Compare the attribution table to the approved allocations and the accepted stage evidence.

Title: Persist contribution records without duplicates
Description: Persist stage-level ContributionRecord rows with @@unique([workOrderId, stageId]) to strictly prevent duplicate earnings during stage retries or fallback replacements. In WH-204, failed v1.0.0 receives ₹0 and replacement v1.1.0 receives ₹2,500; ensure total reconciles exactly to the ₹10,000 allocation.
Outputs: src/server/economics/contributions.ts, contribution read API, uniqueness tests
AcceptanceCriteria: Exactly one accepted contribution per stage; v1.1.0 gets the reconciliation allocation; v1.0.0 gets zero; retry and duplicate execution create no extra rows; totals match the work order.
Verification: Create contributions twice from the same execution; count rows and sum amounts.

Title: Build the buyer spend and transaction view
Description: Create /buyer/transactions with the ₹10,000 transaction, builder allocations, ProofHire fee, execution/recovery reserve, human-review reserve, simulated-payment status and a receipt link. Include empty, loading and error states.
AcceptanceCriteria: All amounts sum to ₹10,000; simulated and not-settled labels are explicit; receipt deep-link works; no value is presented as a real charge.
Verification: Check the arithmetic and labels against the economics fixture; test empty and error states.

Title: Persist settlement eligibility and platform economics
Description: Add SettlementRecord and platform economics aggregation: builder total, platform fee, reserves, actual execution/recovery cost, reserve remaining and simulated eligibility. Only verified executions become ELIGIBLE_SIMULATED; no real payment reference is fabricated.
AcceptanceCriteria: Freelancer eligible amount is ₹5,500; platform fee is ₹2,500; reserves and actual cost reconcile; status is ELIGIBLE_SIMULATED; no SETTLED claim and no provider reference.
Verification: Assert every total, the settlement status and the absence of a provider reference.

Title: Build the builder contributions and earnings view
Description: Create /builder/earnings with per-stage contributions, per-agent totals, v1.0.0 ₹0 replaced reason, v1.1.0 ₹2,500 accepted amount, builder total ₹5,500 and simulated eligibility. Link each row to execution evidence.
AcceptanceCriteria: Replaced version shows ₹0 with a reason; accepted fallback shows ₹2,500; total is ₹5,500; no duplicate rows; status is eligible-simulated, not paid.
Verification: Compare each row to the contribution API and check the total.

Title: Add settlement and payout idempotency tests
Description: Add tests proving duplicate work-order approval, duplicate execution start, retry after replacement and replayed events produce exactly one contribution and one payout per stage. Test a replayed verification event as well.
AcceptanceCriteria: Eight replay/duplicate scenarios produce stable totals; no stage is paid twice; failed version remains at zero.
Verification: Run the suite and inspect contribution and settlement counts.

Title: Build the version-specific reputation panel
Description: Add a reputation panel to agent detail and version views showing auditions, stage successes/failures, recovery provided, accepted contributions, average latency and a reliability score. Make clear it is derived from demo execution evidence and is not a public rating.
AcceptanceCriteria: v1.0.0 shows one failure and 0% reliability; v1.1.0 shows one success and recovery credit; stats do not transfer across versions; demo disclaimer visible.
Verification: Compare both version panels to the stats fixture and check the disclaimer.

Title: Update version reputation exactly once
Description: Update AgentVersionStats from execution evidence with a unique execution+stage+version key. Record the v1.0.0 schema failure, v1.1.0 success and recovery credit, and ignore retries or replayed events.
AcceptanceCriteria: v1.0.0 has 1 failure, 0 successes; v1.1.0 has 1 success, 1 recovery provided; no double increment on retry; reliability is computed in basis points.
Verification: Replay the execution events and compare version stats before/after.

Title: Add the economics summary to the receipt
Description: Add a compact economics section to the receipt: buyer total, builder total, platform fee, reserves, actual recovery cost and platform contribution. Clearly separate simulated amounts from measured runtime costs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer total equals the sum of builder amount, platform fee and reserves; actual cost is labelled measured/simulated as appropriate; arithmetic is exact in paise.
Verification: Check the arithmetic and labels in the receipt print preview.

Title: Expose dashboard aggregation for spend and earnings
Description: Extend buyer and freelancer dashboards with spend, eligible earnings, open jobs, completed outcome and contribution count. Aggregate from persisted records, not hard-coded values, and keep the payload typed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Before the demo spend and earnings are zero; after verification they show ₹10,000 simulated spend and ₹5,500 eligible earnings; both dashboards update without a server restart.
Verification: Query dashboards before and after the demo run; compare to the ledger.

Title: Implement version-specific reputation rules
Description: Implement the reliability and recovery-credit rules over persisted evidence. A failed version must not inherit the fallback success; recovery credit applies only to the version that executed the accepted stage. Keep formulas deterministic and documented.
AcceptanceCriteria: Formula matches documented basis points; v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 remain isolated; no qualitative LLM rating; evidence references are required.
Verification: Run formula tests and a cross-version isolation test.

Title: Reconcile economics against the work order
Description: Add a property-style test asserting builder allocations plus platform fee plus reserves equal the buyer total, reserves never go negative, actual recovery cost does not exceed the reserve, and platform contribution is computed from recorded costs.
AcceptanceCriteria: All totals reconcile to 1,000,000 paise; a deliberately mismatched allocation fails; no floating point drift.
Verification: Run with the valid fixture and one corrupted allocation fixture.

Title: Optional reputation history chart
Description: If time permits, add a small version-scoped chart of audition and execution outcomes. Use persisted records only; do not imply statistical significance from a single demo run.
AcceptanceCriteria: Chart is derived from stats records; disclaimer present; no synthetic trend data.
Verification: Compare chart points to the stats fixture.

Title: No-mock integration: replace mocks with live APIs end to end
Description: Switch NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_MOCKS=false across the entire application and verify that all buyer and builder flows communicate with real Next.js route handlers and SQLite database. Ensure seeded profiles (Northstar, Jordan Lee), simulated inventory (42 -> 42), and simulated settlement remain clearly labelled in the UI.
Outputs: Live-wired UI, parity checklist in the audit/decision log
AcceptanceCriteria: No demo route reads mock fixtures; buyer and builder journeys complete against the live API; refresh preserves state; no console errors.
Verification: Run the route checklist with mocks disabled and record every endpoint seen in the network log.

Title: Harden API envelopes, roles and query performance
Description: Apply one success/error envelope across all routes, consistent status codes and role checks, add missing indexes and remove N+1 queries. Run the contract suite and fix any response that drifts from the frozen schemas.
Outputs: API hardening commit, contract test report
AcceptanceCriteria: All API contract tests pass; no endpoint leaks stack traces; role violations return 403; local p95 under 300ms for dashboard and execution reads.
Verification: Run contract and integration suites; measure the two key endpoints.

Title: Regress compiler, execution and verification on live data
Description: Run the full compile, audition, selection, approval, execution, failure, replacement, verification and receipt chain against the live database. Fix integration defects and compare the canonical output with the expected WH-204 truth.
AcceptanceCriteria: Three consecutive runs produce 10/2/EXCEPTION_REQUIRES_REVIEW, one replacement, ten passing checks and identical key values; no orphan records.
Verification: Run the chain three times and diff canonical outputs.

Title: Complete the premium visual polish pass
Description: Do a final pass on spacing, typography, surface layering, borders, badge semantics, charts, empty states, motion timing, demo labels and loading skeletons. Keep motion functional and short; remove decorative clutter.
AcceptanceCriteria: UI checklist passes; no layout shift on data load; every status colour matches semantics; demo and simulated labels are present.
Verification: Screenshot review against 09_UI_UX_SPECIFICATION.md at three widths.

Title: Harden demo reset and seed reproducibility
Description: Add a single reset command that migrates, seeds and verifies the demo state. Back up the seeded SQLite database, assert exact IDs/counts, and test the topbar reset three times without restarting the server.
AcceptanceCriteria: Three resets yield identical counts and WH-204 state; no orphan rows; backup restores; reset completes under 10 seconds.
Verification: Run reset three times, compare counts, restore the backup.

Title: Freeze deterministic demo mode
Description: Add fixed seed, configurable stage delays, scenario selection (failure or clean), no external provider dependency and deterministic timestamps where they affect output. Document every demo flag in .env.example.
Outputs: Demo config module, env documentation, replay test
AcceptanceCriteria: Offline run succeeds with no API keys; same scenario twice gives the same checks and amounts; demo speed can be adjusted without code changes.
Verification: Disable network access and run twice; compare canonical results.

Title: Responsive QA and overflow fixes
Description: Check every page at 1440, 1280 and 1024. Fix page overflow, clipped tables, graph container height, sticky actions and sidebar behaviour. Record any accepted tablet limitation.
AcceptanceCriteria: No horizontal page scroll at target widths; all primary actions reachable; charts and tables scroll inside their containers.
Verification: Three-width checklist with screenshots for buyer and builder routes.

Title: Trim polling payloads and review indexes
Description: Reduce execution polling to the fields the timeline needs, paginate the event log, and confirm indexes for job, execution, stage and contribution queries. Measure payload size and response time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Execution poll payload under 50KB; dashboard read under 200ms locally; no missing-index warning on the hot queries.
Verification: Measure payload size and timings; run query plans.

Title: Tune audition and execution latency
Description: Batch fixture execution where safe, tune artificial delays and avoid redundant recomputation. Target a full demo flow under 15 seconds and auditions under 60 seconds without changing correctness.
AcceptanceCriteria: Full flow under 15s; audition suite under 60s; results unchanged from the pre-tuning canonical hash.
Verification: Measure three runs and compare canonical hashes before/after.

Title: Optional advanced stage motion
Description: If time permits, add short functional transitions for stage status changes and receipt reveal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion and never delay the demo narrative.
AcceptanceCriteria: Transitions under 250ms; reduced-motion disables them; no effect on data or timing.
Verification: Check with reduced motion enabled and measure the flow duration.

Title: Deferred: audit event browser
Description: Deferred post-hackathon. The raw execution event log is already visible in the stage drawer; a separate cross-job audit browser is not needed for the demo and should not become a dead navigation item.
AcceptanceCriteria: No audit-browser route or navigation item exists.
Verification: Confirm navigation contains no dead audit route.

Title: Regression-test the buyer journey
Description: From reset, run buyer overview → jobs → WH-204 → compile → auditions → selection → work-order approval → execution → failure/replacement → verification → receipt → review → transactions. Log every defect with a task ID.
AcceptanceCriteria: Every buyer step works against live data; no console error; no dead CTA; defects are logged and triaged.
Verification: Run the checklist twice, including one mid-run reload.

Title: Regression-test APIs, database and reset
Description: Run the API contract suite, schema tests, reset tests, unauthorized cases, duplicate approval/execution and seed integrity. Fix defects without changing frozen contracts; log any necessary change as a decision.
AcceptanceCriteria: All contract, integration and reset tests pass; unauthorized requests return 403; duplicate mutations are idempotent; seed counts exact.
Verification: Run the full test command and a fresh reset; attach the summary to the checkpoint.

Title: Run the negative-path acceptance suite
Description: Run invalid schema, agent timeout, contradictory outputs, missing evidence, duplicate execution, unauthorized action, failed replacement, false agent success and retry causing duplicate payout. Every case must produce the documented safe behaviour.
AcceptanceCriteria: Nine negative cases pass; no false success or duplicate payout; failed cases include a typed code and preserved evidence.
Verification: Run the negative suite and map each result to 14_TESTING_AND_ACCEPTANCE_PLAN.md.

Title: Regression-test the builder journey and demo labels
Description: Check builder overview → profile → agents → versions → evaluations → contributions → earnings → reputation. Audit every demo, seeded, simulated and deferred label, and remove any claim that overstates implementation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Builder journey works; v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 stats are isolated; every simulated value is labelled; no dead link or fake action.
Verification: Run the builder checklist and the label grep against the demo truth table.

Title: Replay verification and economics determinism
Description: Run the full chain three times and compare receipt hashes, acceptance results, contribution rows and settlement totals. Fix any nondeterminism from timestamps, ordering or random IDs that affects canonical output.
AcceptanceCriteria: Three runs produce identical check results, amounts and receipt hash; only non-canonical timestamps/IDs differ.
Verification: Diff canonical JSON across three runs and compare hashes.

Title: Produce the final seeded database and restore path
Description: Create a known-good seeded SQLite artifact, document restore and fresh-clone seeding, and verify a clean checkout reaches the demo state in under five minutes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Fresh clone plus documented commands reaches CONTRACT_READY; restored DB has identical IDs/counts; no secret in the artifact.
Verification: Restore into a temp directory and run the seed integrity query.

Title: Freeze the UI and verify the production build
Description: Remove debug panels, temporary toggles and console logs. Run the production build, capture final screenshots for the runbook, and verify no mock-only copy remains.
AcceptanceCriteria: npm run build succeeds; no debug UI; screenshots match the current app; no mock label remains where live data is required.
Verification: Run build and start; click through the screenshot set.

Title: Final checkpoint, tag and run instructions
Description: Run the final migration/seed/build checks, update README run commands and .env.example, create the v1.0-demo tag and record the final decision-log state. Do not change frozen contracts after this point.
Outputs: v1.0-demo tag, final README run section
AcceptanceCriteria: Clean working tree for code; tag exists; documented commands reproduce the demo; no unlogged contract change.
Verification: Tag, fresh-clone smoke command and decision-log review.

Title: Rehearse the compiler-to-economics chain three times
Description: Rehearse compile → audition → selection → execution → failure → fallback → verification → receipt → economics three times with Teams A and B, record timings and any manual steps, and update the runbook with observed behaviour.
AcceptanceCriteria: Three of three rehearsals reach verified receipt and eligible simulation; timings recorded; no unrehearsed manual fix.
Verification: Time each rehearsal end to end and attach the log.

Title: Rehearse the three-minute judge demonstration
Description: Deliver the full judge script three times with the real UI, physical fixtures and a reset before each run. Fix blockers, freeze copy and sign off the runbook. Target under 3:15 with the failure moment visible.
AcceptanceCriteria: Three complete runs; failure and replacement visible; verification and economics shown; no run exceeds 3:15.
Verification: Use a visible timer and the runbook checklist for each run.

Title: Verify the demo environment and offline fallback
Description: Confirm Node 22, ports, SQLite write permissions, browser, screen resolution, demo flags and no external API dependency. Document the offline and broken-API fallbacks in the runbook.
AcceptanceCriteria: Demo runs with network disabled; ports documented; reset works from the UI; recovery steps tested.
Verification: Disable network, run the flow, and follow each fallback step.

Title: Optional extra adversarial fixtures
Description: If time permits, add two additional adversarial audition fixtures (prompt-injection text in a document and duplicate receiving event). Do not change the frozen suite version or the demo selection without a decision-log entry.
AcceptanceCriteria: New fixtures pass expected assertions; existing selection unchanged; suite version documented.
Verification: Run old and new suites; compare selection and totals.
